bio.text: Brandon Mitchell represents Idaho House District 6, Seat B, and lives in the Moscow area; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a third term and describes him as a small business owner.

The legislature biography says he was raised in Syracuse, Utah, graduated from Clearfield High School in 1988, attended Weber State University, and finished his degree at Brigham Young University-Idaho.
The biography adds that he has co-owned a small business with his wife since January 2013.
